Your responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 on-site Digital Workplace & End User Support for a large international manufacturing organization.
  • Handle incidents, service requests and ticket management through to resolution.
  • Deliver Level 1 Service Desk activities as a primary assignment.
  • Support workplace projects, hardware/software deployments and lifecycle management.
  • Install, configure and troubleshoot end-user devices, operating systems and applications.
  • Support laptops, desktops, printers, mobile devices and meeting-room technology.
  • Coordinate escalations with Level 3 teams, infrastructure, security and external vendors.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and drive service improvements.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles and procedures.
  • Execute knowledge transfer activities and support operational excellence.

Our requirements

  • 3-5+ years of enterprise Level 2 End User Support / Digital Workplace experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows 11 and Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Hands-on experience with: Microsoft Teams, Active Directory & Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM), ITSM / ticketing platforms.
  • Experience supporting endpoint devices, peripherals and workplace technologies.
  • Good understanding of LAN/Wi-Fi troubleshooting and enterprise applications.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience with device provisioning, migrations, deployments and lifecycle management.
  • Strong documentation, communication and knowledge-sharing skills.
  • Fluent Polish and good working proficiency in English.
  • Availability for primarily on-site work in Southern Poland.
  • Service-oriented mindset with focus on SLA achievement, ticket quality and continuous improvement.
